scope: Small public samples from six remaining NLSP studies plus ACTES and ITBA; no bulk archive, real importer, application behavior, commit, push or environment publication.

datasets.title: Bone Densitometry Assessment (Flight Analog)

creators_as_registered.name: Technical Assistant to Principal Investigator: Evans, Harlan

datasets.citation: Principal Investigator: Sibonga, Jean D.; Technical Assistant to Principal Investigator: Evans, Harlan (2026). Bone Densitometry Assessment (Flight Analog) [Dataset]. Ames Research Center. https://doi.org/10.83263/7myc-5j86

inspection.unit_status: NET_AVG_BMD unit not declared in CSV or reviewed readme; do not assume g/cm2.
inspection.time: SCAN_DATE and BR_DAY/TEST_PHASE; no authoritative timezone; preserve raw dates.
limits: Readme documents 2006 calibration correction factors; sample file is a different subject/date context. Do not apply those factors to this sample or apply them twice.
Heel DXA assessment is not a continuous sensor.

datasets.title: Bed Rest Standard Measures: General Immunity
datasets.citation: Co-Investigator: Crucian, Brian E.; Principal Investigator: Sams, Clarence F. (2026). Bed Rest Standard Measures: General Immunity [Dataset]. Ames Research Center. https://doi.org/10.83263/75we-ch31

inspection.unit_status: No per-analyte unit declared in selected CD8+ CD69+ CSV; percent/count semantics unconfirmed.
inspection.time: Protocol labels L-10,L-2,28/45,60/83,90,R+5/14; not ISO dates or uniform intervals.
limits: Do not split composite labels into invented dates. A protocol-relative time representation/mapping is needed before import; schema2 calendar fields alone do not represent this axis.
Requires laboratory measurements, not inference from vitals.

datasets.title: Aerobic Capacity (Flight Analog)

creators_as_registered.name: Principal Investigator: Moore, Alan D., Jr.
Technical Assistant to Principal Investigator: Wilson, Cassie A.
Technical Assistant to Principal Investigator: Everett-Downs, Meghan

datasets.citation: Principal Investigator: Moore, Alan D., Jr.; Technical Assistant to Principal Investigator: Wilson, Cassie A.; Principal Investigator: Ploutz- Snyder, Lori; Technical Assistant to Principal Investigator: Everett-Downs, Meghan (2026). Aerobic Capacity (Flight Analog) [Dataset]. Ames Research Center. https://doi.org/10.83263/w056-8t76

inspection.unit_status: Time (min) and VO2 (ml/kg/min) explicit headers. HR is labelled bpm in matching test readme; do not infer unqualified VO2,VCO2,VE,FEO2 or FECO2 units.
inspection.time: Date, stage, test phase and BR_Day; timezone not established.
limits: Matching source readme f7321c09-1069-5b0a-b283-6cb509d69db8 corresponds to sample 060507; an earlier inspected060821 readme is retained as a separate artifact and is not evidence for this test.
Keep exercise physiology separate from resting HR and do not conflate absolute and weight-normalized VO2.

datasets.title: Radiation Measurements in Shuttle Crew Compartment
datasets.citation: Principal Investigator: Badhwar, Gautam (2026). Radiation Measurements in Shuttle Crew Compartment [Dataset]. Ames Research Center. https://doi.org/10.83263/0d67-bk75

inspection.unit_status: First XLS explicitly distinguishes neutron absorbed dose rate microGy/day and equivalent dose rate microSv/day. Second XLS dose-rate header is garbled I1Gy/day; preserve rather than silently repair.
inspection.time: Shuttle missions, altitude and detector locations; no participant timestamps or personal exposures.
limits: Text cells contain estimates and uncertainties; do not parse as plain scalar or invent clinical dose limits.
Header/description inconsistencies require source review before conversion.

datasets.title: The Effects of EVA and Long-Term Exposure to Microgravity on Pulmonary Function
datasets.citation: Co-Investigator: Darquenne, Chantal; Co-Investigator: Elliott, Ann; Co-Investigator: Paiva, Manuel; Co-Investigator: Prisk, G.; Principal Investigator: West, John (2026). The Effects of EVA and Long-Term Exposure to Microgravity on Pulmonary Function [Dataset]. Ames Research Center. https://doi.org/10.83263/7nhp-yt75

inspection.unit_status: mmHg explicitly in four maximum-respiratory-pressure column headers.
inspection.time: Preflight/early and late in-flight/postflight grouped assessments, not individual UTC timestamps.
limits: Means +/- SE with number of measurements in parentheses; do not treat rows/counts as individual astronauts.
Public sample only; protected records were not requested or accessed.

datasets.title: Toxicological Assessment of Airborne Volatile Organic Compounds
datasets.citation: Co-Investigator: Beck, Steve; Co-Investigator: Boyd, John; Co-Investigator: Covington, Phillip; Co-Investigator: Limero, Thomas; Co-Investigator: Lind, Debra; Co-Investigator: Martin, Mildred; Co-Investigator: Matney, Marilyn; Co-Investigator: Yang, Lily; Principal Investigator: James, John (2026). Toxicological Assessment of Airborne Volatile Organic Compounds [Dataset]. Ames Research Center. https://doi.org/10.83263/xj28-wp80

inspection.unit_status: First dataset metadata declares CO2 partial pressure mmHg; XLS cells contain labels/chart only. Second table contains T-VALUE toxicity indexes, not measured concentrations or CO2 ppm.
inspection.time: Sample intervals, date/time and Mir location context; timezone not established.
limits: No numeric CO2 cell series is recoverable from the selected workbook using cell inspection; graph digitization not performed.
Keep index, concentration and personal exposure distinct. Do not turn a T-value into a clinical threshold.

inspection.unit_evidence: Data_Dictionary.csv plus IBI-specific README text; dictionary units unspecified for IBI, resolved by README.
inspection.time: README explicitly declares UTC; calendar is shifted for de-identification, consistently across records. Preserve declared UTC and shift status; never align participants by shifted dates. HR begins10 seconds after TEMP/IBI in this session.
limits: HR/TEMP: date-text first row and rate second row. IBI: one row with two date strings then offset/duration pairs; second row is data, not sampling rate.
Dictionary and constraints are not UTF8; cp1252 decoding used for inspection only, original bytes retained.
Respect documented duplicated/invalid sensors, interrupted and missing sessions; do not treat all sessions as clean.
Future importer must retain shifted-UTC context; current core does not allow source_time alongside UTC time. No importer or schema extension implemented here.
